title: New Orleans Style Fishing Charters
specs: Fish in backwater marsh, lakes, bays, and bayous in less than 5 feet of water
Target species include red fish, speckle trout, sheepshead, and black drum
Fishing license required for anyone 18 years or older, $20, can be purchased online or by phone
Anyone 4 years old or older welcome
Maximum 4 customers per boat; private charters only with captain and guests

options.name: Evening Fishing Charter
options.detail: Evening fishing trips available depending on scheduling.

variants.label: Evening fishing trips available depending on scheduling.

includes: All rod and reels, bait, tackle, ice, fuel, and bottled water for a 5-hour trip
Gas and oil included in charter fees
blurb: Guests fish for species like red fish, speckle trout, sheepshead, and black drum in shallow waters around Lafitte and the Barataria estuary. Trips start at safe light from Joe's Landing and last 5 hours, with evening trips sometimes available. All gear, bait, tackle, ice, fuel, and bottled water are provided, and the catch is cleaned for guests.
extraNote: Tips are accepted and appreciated but not expected · If inclement weather prevents fishing, no deposit will be charged; may reschedule if openings and guest available · Joe's Landing
